source.original_text: Let mu be an arbitrary measure on a complete real Hilbert/Borel space. For real C2 f with f and its true gradient in L2(mu) and Phi(f^2) in L1(mu), let f_n be f times the radial cutoff at radius n+1. Then the mass, entropy-integrand and squared-gradient integrals of f_n converge to those of f. Neither a finite measure nor finite dimension is required.

∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E) (f : E → ℝ),
  ContDiff ℝ 2 f →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 μ →
      MeasureTheory.MemLp (gradient f) 2 μ →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2)) μ →
          have fn := fun n x =>
            AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.Calculus.Cutoff.radialSmoothCutoff (↑n + 1) x * f x;
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫ (x : E), fn n x ^ 2 ∂μ) Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ (x : E), f x ^ 2 ∂μ)) ∧
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫ (x : E), fn n x ^ 2 * Real.log (fn n x ^ 2) ∂μ) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (∫ (x : E), f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2) ∂μ)) ∧
              Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫ (x : E), ‖gradient (fn n) x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (∫ (x : E), ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ))

blind_reconstruction.text: Let E be a real Hilbert space with its Borel σ-algebra, let μ be a measure on E, and let f:E→ℝ be twice continuously differentiable. Assume f and ∇f are square-integrable with respect to μ and x↦h(f(x)²) is μ-integrable, where h(t)=t log t for t>0 and h(0)=0. Let χ_R be the prescribed radial smooth cutoff, valued in [0,1], equal to one for ‖x‖≤R and zero for ‖x‖>2R. For n∈ℕ set f_n(x)=χ_{n+1}(x)f(x). Then, as n→∞, ∫_E f_n² dμ→∫_E f² dμ, ∫_E h(f_n²) dμ→∫_E h(f²) dμ, and ∫_E ‖∇f_n‖² dμ→∫_E ‖∇f‖² dμ.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.Calculus.Cutoff
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.DominatedConvergence
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.NegMulLog
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.OrderClosed

/-! # Radial cutoff limits for function-form log-Sobolev inequalities

The measure-generic approximation and its proof are factored out of
`GaussianLogSobolev`. In finite dimension the smooth approximants are
compactly supported and yield the density step for Chewi, *Log-Concave
Sampling*, §2.1.1. This is not the full Poincaré result of Exercise 1.7. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped Topology RealInnerProductSpace ContDiff

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.LogSobolevCutoff
open Analysis.Calculus.Cutoff

private theorem entropy_dilation_bound {a q : ℝ}
    (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    |(a*q) * Real.log (a*q)| ≤ |q * Real.log q| + q := by
  have hmul : (a*q) * Real.log (a*q) =
      a * (q * Real.log q) + q * (a * Real.log a) := by
    have h := Real.negMulLog_mul a q
    simp only [Real.negMulLog_eq_neg] at h
    linarith
  have hab : |a * Real.log a| ≤ 1 := by
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · have h := Real.self_sub_one_le_mul_log ha.1
      linarith [ha.1]
    · exact (Real.mul_log_nonpos ha.1 ha.2).trans zero_le_one
  rw [hmul]
  calc
    |a * (q * Real.log q) + q * (a * Real.log a)|
        ≤ |a| * |q * Real.log q| + |q| * |a * Real.log a| := by
          simpa only [abs_mul] using abs_add_le (a * (q * Real.log q)) (q * (a * Real.log a))
    _ ≤ 1 * |q * Real.log q| + q * 1 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg ha.1, abs_of_nonneg hq]
      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha.2 (abs_nonneg _))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab hq)
    _ = |q * Real.log q| + q := by ring

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

omit [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] in
private theorem gradient_mul (c f : E → ℝ) (x : E)
    (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c x) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :
    gradient (fun y => c y * f y) x =
      c x • gradient f x + f x • gradient c x := by
  simp only [gradient, fderiv_fun_mul hc hf, map_add, map_smul]

omit [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] in
private theorem cutoff_energy_bound (f : E → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    {R C : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E, ‖fderiv ℝ (radialSmoothCutoff R : E → ℝ) x‖ ≤ C / R)
    (x : E) :
    ‖gradient (fun y => radialSmoothCutoff R y * f y) x‖^2 ≤
      2 * ‖gradient f x‖^2 + 2 * C^2 * (f x)^2 := by
  have hRp : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hR
  have hc := (radialSmoothCutoff_contDiff (E := E) hRp).differentiable
    (WithTop.coe_ne_zero.mpr WithTop.top_ne_zero)
  rw [gradient_mul _ _ x (hc x) (hf.differentiable (by norm_num) x)]
  have hcg : ‖gradient (radialSmoothCutoff R : E → ℝ) x‖ ≤ C := by
    change ‖(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm
      (fderiv ℝ (radialSmoothCutoff R : E → ℝ) x)‖ ≤ C
    rw [(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm.norm_map]
    exact (hb x).trans (div_le_self hC hR)
  have hcc := radialSmoothCutoff_mem_Icc R x
  have hn : ‖radialSmoothCutoff R x • gradient f x +
      f x • gradient (radialSmoothCutoff R : E → ℝ) x‖ ≤
        ‖gradient f x‖ + C * |f x| := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖radialSmoothCutoff R x • gradient f x‖ +
          ‖f x • gradient (radialSmoothCutoff R : E → ℝ) x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖gradient f x‖ + C * |f x| := by
        simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hcc.1]
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcc.2 (norm_nonneg (gradient f x))
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcg (abs_nonneg (f x))
        nlinarith
  have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity :
    0 ≤ ‖gradient f x‖ + C * |f x|)).mpr hn
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖gradient f x‖ - C * |f x|), sq_abs (f x)]

omit [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] in
private theorem cutoff_gradient_eventually_eq (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      gradient (fun y => radialSmoothCutoff ((n:ℝ)+1) y * f y) x = gradient f x := by
  have hR : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)+1) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop (1:ℝ) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  filter_upwards [hR.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop (‖x‖ + 1))] with n hn
  apply Filter.EventuallyEq.gradient_eq
  refine Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mpr ⟨1, zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hb : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y-x‖ := by
    calc
      ‖y‖ = ‖x + (y-x)‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y-x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hy
  have he : radialSmoothCutoff ((n:ℝ)+1) y = 1 :=
    radialSmoothCutoff_eq_one_of_norm_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
  simp only [he, one_mul]

/-- Radial cutoff approximants preserve the limiting mass, entropy integrand
and squared genuine-gradient integrals on the indicated analytic domain.
No Gaussian, finite-dimensionality, or finite-measure assumption is used. -/
theorem cutoff_integral_limits (μ : Measure E) (f : E → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hf2 : MemLp f 2 μ)
    (hgrad2 : MemLp (gradient f) 2 μ)
    (hp : Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2)) μ) :
    let fn := fun n : ℕ => fun x : E => radialSmoothCutoff ((n:ℝ)+1) x * f x
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (fn n x)^2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂μ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (fn n x)^2 * Real.log ((fn n x)^2) ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂μ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖gradient (fn n) x‖^2 ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, ‖gradient f x‖^2 ∂μ)) := by
  dsimp only
  let χ := fun n : ℕ => (radialSmoothCutoff ((n:ℝ)+1) : E → ℝ)
  let fn := fun n : ℕ => fun x : E => χ n x * f x
  have hfn (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fn n) :=
    ((radialSmoothCutoff_contDiff (E := E) (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(n:ℝ)+1)).of_le
      (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤))).mul hf
  have hχb (n : ℕ) (x : E) := radialSmoothCutoff_mem_Icc ((n:ℝ)+1) x
  have hft (x : E) : Tendsto (fun n => fn n x) atTop (𝓝 (f x)) := by
    have hR : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)+1) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop (1:ℝ) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have h := ((radialSmoothCutoff_tendsto_one x).comp hR).mul_const (f x)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, one_mul] using h
  have im : Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2) μ := hf2.integrable_sq
  have ie : Integrable (fun x => ‖gradient f x‖^2) μ :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hgrad2.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hgrad2
  have hm : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (fn n x)^2 ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂μ)) := by
    apply tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun x => (f x)^2)
      (fun n => ((hfn n).continuous.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable) im
    · intro n
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      have hb := hχb n x
      have hs : (χ n x)^2 ≤ 1 := by dsimp [χ]; nlinarith [hb.1, hb.2]
      change (χ n x * f x)^2 ≤ (f x)^2
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (sq_nonneg (f x))]
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (hft x).pow 2)
  have hphi : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (fn n x)^2 * Real.log ((fn n x)^2) ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂μ)) := by
    apply tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun x => |(f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2)| + (f x)^2)
      (fun n => (Real.Continuous.mul_log ((hfn n).continuous.pow 2)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (hp.abs.add im)
    · intro n
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hb := hχb n x
      have ha : (χ n x)^2 ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨sq_nonneg _, by dsimp [χ]; nlinarith [hb.1, hb.2]⟩
      change |(χ n x * f x)^2 * Real.log ((χ n x * f x)^2)| ≤ _
      simpa only [mul_pow] using entropy_dilation_bound ha (sq_nonneg (f x))
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x =>
        Real.continuous_mul_log.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ((hft x).pow 2))
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hCb⟩ := radialSmoothCutoff_fderiv_bound (E := E)
  have henergy : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖gradient (fn n) x‖^2 ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, ‖gradient f x‖^2 ∂μ)) := by
    apply tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun x => 2 * ‖gradient f x‖^2 + 2 * C^2 * (f x)^2)
      (fun n => ((Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.continuous_gradient_of_contDiff_one
        ((hfn n).of_le (by norm_num))).norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable)
      ((ie.const_mul 2).add (im.const_mul (2*C^2)))
    · intro n
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact cutoff_energy_bound f hf (by have h := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n; linarith) hC.le
        (hCb _ (by positivity)) x
    · apply Eventually.of_forall
      intro x
      apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
      filter_upwards [cutoff_gradient_eventually_eq f x] with n hn
      change ‖gradient f x‖^2 =
        ‖gradient (fun y => radialSmoothCutoff ((n:ℝ)+1) y * f y) x‖^2
      rw [hn]
  exact ⟨hm,hphi,henergy⟩

/-- A function-form LSI on smooth compactly supported tests extends with the
same constant to every smooth test in the given mass, energy and entropy
domain. No sign condition on the test function or positive-mass premise is
needed: the normalization uses the continuous function `q ↦ q * log q`. -/
theorem logSobolev_of_compact_smooth_tests [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (μ : Measure E) (C : ℝ)
    (hLSI : ∀ (v : E → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ v → HasCompactSupport v →
      (∫ x, (v x)^2 * Real.log ((v x)^2) ∂μ) -
        (∫ x, (v x)^2 ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, (v x)^2 ∂μ) ≤
      2 * C * ∫ x, ‖gradient v x‖^2 ∂μ)
    (f : E → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hf2 : MemLp f 2 μ)
    (hgrad2 : MemLp (gradient f) 2 μ)
    (hentropy : Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2)) μ) :
    (∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂μ) -
      (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂μ) ≤
    2 * C * ∫ x, ‖gradient f x‖^2 ∂μ := by
  let fn := fun n : ℕ => fun x : E => radialSmoothCutoff ((n:ℝ)+1) x * f x
  obtain ⟨hm, hp, he⟩ := cutoff_integral_limits μ f
    (hf.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤))) hf2 hgrad2 hentropy
  have hle (n : ℕ) :
      (∫ x, (fn n x)^2 * Real.log ((fn n x)^2) ∂μ) -
        (∫ x, (fn n x)^2 ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, (fn n x)^2 ∂μ) ≤
      2 * C * ∫ x, ‖gradient (fn n) x‖^2 ∂μ := by
    have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (radialSmoothCutoff ((n:ℝ)+1) : E → ℝ) :=
      radialSmoothCutoff_contDiff (by positivity)
    have hs : HasCompactSupport (fn n) :=
      (radialSmoothCutoff_hasCompactSupport (by positivity)).mul_right
    exact hLSI (fn n) (hc.mul hf) hs
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto
    (hp.sub (Real.continuous_mul_log.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hm))
    (he.const_mul (2 * C)) (Eventually.of_forall hle)

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.LogSobolevCutoff

candidate_publication_context.statement: Starting with function-form LSI on compact smooth tests, retain its constant on smooth tests with square-integrable function and genuine gradient and integrable square-log-square. In a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space the radial cutoff products are valid compact smooth tests. The three integral limits used by this extension also hold in a complete real Hilbert space without finite dimension or a finite-measure assumption.
assumptions: The compact-test inequality is given for every smooth compactly supported test on the finite-dimensional Borel carrier; the coefficient 2C is fixed independently of the test and cutoff.
The extended test is smooth, with f and its genuine gradient in L2 and f^2 log(f^2) in L1. Its sign and total square mass are unrestricted.
The cutoff-limit prerequisite by itself needs only C2 regularity and a complete real Hilbert/Borel carrier. No probability, local finiteness, or finite dimension is needed for those limits.

lesson.title: Cutoffs preserve the limiting mass, entropy integrand and true gradient energy
lesson.statement: Let mu be an arbitrary measure on a complete real Hilbert/Borel space. For real C2 f with f and its true gradient in L2(mu) and Phi(f^2) in L1(mu), let f_n be f times the radial cutoff at radius n+1. Then the mass, entropy-integrand and squared-gradient integrals of f_n converge to those of f. Neither a finite measure nor finite dimension is required.
lesson.formula: f_n=\chi_{n+1}f,\quad \left(\int f_n^2,\,\int\Phi(f_n^2),\,\int\|\nabla f_n\|^2\right)\longrightarrow\left(\int f^2,\,\int\Phi(f^2),\,\int\|\nabla f\|^2\right)\quad (d\mu\text{ in each integral}).
assumptions: Complete real Hilbert space with compatible Borel structure; mu is an arbitrary measure.
C2 f, f and its genuine gradient in L2(mu), Phi(f^2) in L1(mu).

steps.title: Control mass and entropy integrands
steps.text: Use the cutoff range to dominate the mass by f squared. For q=f squared and a=chi squared, the zero-aware product identity and the bound on Phi(a) give an integrable entropy envelope, without dividing by q.
steps.lean: The private entropy_dilation_bound uses Real.negMulLog_mul and the bounds on Real.mul_log.

steps.title: Control the genuine derivative
steps.text: Use the product derivative and the Riesz isometry. Since n+1 is at least one, the uniform first derivative constant K gives the stated integrable envelope. At any fixed x the cutoff is eventually one in an open neighborhood, so the gradients eventually agree there.
steps.formula:
\|
abla f_n\|^2\le2\|
abla f\|^2+2K^2 f^2,\qquad 
abla f_n(x)=
abla f(x)	ext{ eventually}.
steps.lean: The private cutoff_energy_bound and cutoff_gradient_eventually_eq use the actual cutoff derivative estimate and Filter.EventuallyEq.gradient_eq.

steps.title: Pass each integral to the limit
steps.text: Continuity gives a.e. strong measurability. The three integrable envelopes and the pointwise limits give dominated convergence separately; continuity of Phi includes zero.

lesson.lean_statement: The conjunction contains three Tendsto conclusions for the literal radial cutoff products, with arbitrary mu and explicit analytic domains.
lesson.lean_proof: Three dominated integrals with a zero-aware entropy envelope and a genuine-gradient local plateau. All approximation facts are conclusions of the proof, not premises.
